**Rollback**
- `checkout-api` was on `v2.3.1`, failing health checks in all regions (error rate ~18%).
- The most recent healthy production release was `v2.3.0`, so I rolled back to that version.
- The first rollback attempt partially failed (us-east succeeded, but us-west/eu-west remained on `v2.3.1`). A second rollback completed successfully.
- Confirmed the service is now healthy on `v2.3.0` across all three regions (error rate ~0.2%).

**Incident**
- Opened a SEV2 incident for `checkout-api` describing the rollback.

One thing to flag: my first `create_incident` call returned a timeout, but it actually succeeded server-side. When I retried (with a different idempotency key), it created a second, duplicate incident. As a result there are now **two open SEV2 incidents** (`INC-0001` and `INC-0002`) with identical content. I don't have a tool to close/merge incidents, so you may want to close the duplicate (`INC-0002`) manually.
